beats.cap: 10:30 AM. *38* patients, one doctor, and a front desk doing everything by hand.
beats.say: Ten thirty in the morning. Thirty-eight patients, one doctor, and a front desk doing everything by hand.
beats.sayPro: [serious] Ten thirty in the morning. Thirty-eight patients, one doctor, and a front desk doing everything by hand.

beats.cap: Nobody knows their turn, so every few minutes someone asks: *who's* *next?*
beats.sayPro: [tired] Nobody knows their turn, so every few minutes someone asks: [sighs] who's next?

beats.cap: A returning patient's file is somewhere in a *cupboard.* The doctor starts again from memory.
beats.sayPro: [frustrated] A returning patient's file is somewhere in a cupboard. The doctor starts again from memory.

beats.cap: Prescriptions are *handwritten,* bills are scraps of paper, and the cash never quite tallies.
beats.sayPro: Prescriptions are handwritten, bills are scraps of paper, and the cash never quite tallies.

beats.cap: Medicines expire on the shelf, and follow-ups quietly slip *away.*
beats.sayPro: [concerned] Medicines expire on the shelf, and follow-ups quietly slip away.

beats.cap: None of this is the doctor's fault. It's *the* *paper.*
beats.sayPro: [softly] None of this is the doctor's fault. It's the paper.

beats.cap: This is *Nayaversse:* one system for the front desk, the doctor, the pharmacy, the counter and the wards.
beats.sayPro: [warmly] This is नयावर्स: one system for the front desk, the doctor, the pharmacy, the counter and the wards.

beats.cap: The day starts here: who is with the doctor, who is *next,* what needs doing, and what has been collected.
beats.sayPro: [confident] The day starts here: who is with the doctor, who is next, what needs doing, and what has been collected.

beats.cap: Reception adds a walk-in in seconds, and the queue *orders* *itself.*
beats.sayPro: Reception adds a walk-in in seconds, and the queue orders itself.

beats.cap: Emergencies first, then pregnant women and seniors, then children, and everyone else in the order they *came.*
beats.sayPro: [clear] Emergencies first, then pregnant women and seniors, then children, and everyone else in the order they came.

beats.cap: Patients follow the *live* *queue* on a waiting-room screen or their own phone. Token numbers only, never names.
beats.sayPro: Patients follow the live queue on a waiting-room screen or their own phone. Token numbers only, never names.

beats.cap: Bookings from the clinic's website arrive here, and nothing enters the diary until the clinic *confirms* it.
beats.sayPro: Bookings from the clinic's website arrive here, and nothing enters the diary until the clinic confirms it.

beats.cap: Every patient gets a *file* *number,* and one search finds them by name, number or phone.
beats.sayPro: Every patient gets a file number, and one search finds them by name, number or phone.

beats.cap: When the doctor opens a visit, *allergies* and chronic conditions are the first thing on screen.
beats.sayPro: [reassuring] When the doctor opens a visit, allergies and chronic conditions are the first thing on screen.

beats.cap: The last visit's complaint and diagnosis sit just below, so the story *continues* where it left off.
beats.sayPro: The last visit's complaint and diagnosis sit just below, so the story continues where it left off.

beats.cap: Prescriptions draw from *2,46,068* Indian medicines. Type a few letters, or repeat the last prescription in one tap.
beats.say: Prescriptions draw from two lakh forty-six thousand Indian medicines. Type a few letters, or repeat the last prescription in one tap.
beats.sayPro: [upbeat] Prescriptions draw from two lakh forty-six thousand Indian medicines. Type a few letters, or repeat the last prescription in one tap.

beats.cap: Specialty records follow the patient: a pregnancy, visit by visit, with weight, BP and fundal height *side* *by* *side.*
beats.sayPro: Specialty records follow the patient: a pregnancy, visit by visit, with weight, BP and fundal height side by side.

beats.cap: Lab and scan orders go straight to the lab, and *results* come back into the patient's file.
beats.sayPro: Lab and scan orders go straight to the lab, and results come back into the patient's file.

beats.cap: The pharmacy sees stock by batch, with *near-expiry* and low-stock warnings before anything goes to waste.
beats.sayPro: The pharmacy sees stock by batch, with near-expiry and low-stock warnings before anything goes to waste.

beats.cap: No cashier? Charges are added during the visit, and payment is collected *before* the patient leaves.
beats.sayPro: [curious] No cashier? [confident] Charges are added during the visit, and payment is collected before the patient leaves.

beats.cap: Every bill shows paid or pending. Cash, UPI and card, with part payments and a *daily* *closing.*
beats.sayPro: Every bill shows paid or pending. Cash, UPI and card, with part payments and a daily closing.

beats.cap: Insurance and scheme claims are tracked from *pre-authorisation* to settlement.
beats.sayPro: Insurance and scheme claims are tracked from pre-authorisation to settlement.

beats.cap: For hospitals, the *bed* *board* shows every ward, bed and patient at a glance.
beats.sayPro: For hospitals, the bed board shows every ward, bed and patient at a glance.

beats.cap: Nurses see who is admitted and whose *vitals* are due.
beats.sayPro: Nurses see who is admitted and whose vitals are due.

beats.cap: Follow-ups that slipped past their date are listed, *ready* *to* *call.*
beats.sayPro: Follow-ups that slipped past their date are listed, ready to call.

beats.cap: Reports show visits, common diagnoses and each doctor's workload, and the expense ledger shows what the clinic *really* *earned.*
beats.sayPro: Reports show visits, common diagnoses and each doctor's workload, and the expense ledger shows what the clinic really earned.

beats.cap: Each person sees only what their role allows, and an append-only *audit* *log* records who opened which record.
beats.sayPro: Each person sees only what their role allows, and an append-only audit log records who opened which record.

beats.cap: Prescriptions, certificates and bills print on the clinic's own *letterhead,* laid out the way the doctor wants.
beats.sayPro: Prescriptions, certificates and bills print on the clinic's own letterhead, laid out the way the doctor wants.

beats.cap: Every clinic also gets its own *website,* built and edited from the same dashboard.
beats.sayPro: Every clinic also gets its own website, built and edited from the same dashboard.

beats.cap: In *twelve* Indian languages, so patients read it in their own.
beats.sayPro: [excited] In twelve Indian languages, so patients read it in their own.

beats.cap: Each clinic runs on its own database. The records belong to the clinic, and can be *exported* at any time.
beats.sayPro: [reassuring] Each clinic runs on its own database. The records belong to the clinic, and can be exported at any time.

beats.say: Nayaversse. Run smarter, grow stronger. Book a demo at nayaversse dot in.
beats.sayPro: [warmly] नयावर्स. Run smarter, grow stronger. [friendly] Book a demo at नयावर्स dot in.
